name: truthound
description: Local data quality checks, aggregate profiles and sampled PII detection using Truthound Core 3.2.0.

interface.longDescription: Check nulls and duplicates, summarize columns and estimate sampled PII in explicitly approved local directories. No directories are approved by installation. Local desktop execution only; not a hosted ChatGPT web connector or an OpenAI-reviewed public listing.
defaultPrompt: Set up Truthound for a local data directory I approve.
Check this approved CSV for nulls and duplicate rows.
